name: Prefix-$k$ Littlestone Dimension of Half-intervals
proof: For every fixed $k>1$, depth two would be level-constant on its first two levels and would shatter two coordinates. Since VC dimension is one, the value is at most one; a one-point VC witness gives equality.
references: Directly from the prefix-tree definition and the threshold calculations in \cite{littlestone1988learning}.
